app.name: SproutPace
app.summary: Offline-first home microgreens planner that shows the next useful action for every tray and keeps repeated harvests feasible within real growing capacity.

requirements.title: Start quickly and form a first feasible plan
Manage growing zones and tray-size presets
Use a versioned built-in catalog and personal grow recipes
Track each grow batch through its real lifecycle
Plan harvest cadence and continuous tray flow against capacity
Surface useful actions and resilient reminders
Keep dated observations and local photos
Close, review, and repeat grow cycles without losing history
Back up, restore, export, and erase local data safely
Show limited Yandex ads only after the privacy gate permits them
Collect privacy-minimized crash diagnostics with user control
Remain localized, accessible, adaptive, and useful offline
Accounts, cloud synchronization, and a product backend
requirements.reason: The approved MVP is local and offline-first; backup and restore cover portability without accounts or sync.

requirements.title: AI, OCR, and photo diagnosis
requirements.reason: The MVP records photos but does not infer crop health or require paid or unverified ML services.

requirements.title: IoT lights, sensors, and device control
requirements.reason: The product plans human actions and has no approved hardware integration.

requirements.title: Social, commerce, order, and farm inventory features
requirements.reason: The audience is a home grower with several trays, not a commercial farm or social marketplace.

requirements.title: Subscriptions, paid feature limits, and video lessons
requirements.reason: The approved monetization is lightweight advertising and core tray capacity is never paywalled.

requirements.title: Consumption tracking, storage-life prediction, yield forecasting, and monthly calendar
requirements.reason: These features introduce false precision or duplicate a calendar instead of supporting the approved tray pipeline.

requirements.title: Firebase Analytics and attribution
requirements.reason: Only Crashlytics is approved; product-event analytics and attribution would add a separate privacy inventory.

requirements.title: Fullscreen, rewarded, sticky, app-open, mediated, or non-Yandex ads
requirements.reason: Only one inline ad on each approved browse/history surface is allowed; the lightweight consent flow is Yandex-only.

requirements.title: iOS publication and iOS production advertising
requirements.reason: The iOS target is fully implemented and CI/macOS verified but is not published and has no production Yandex ad project in this scope.

update.reason: A backup is immutable; a new archive is created instead of modifying an existing external file.

delete.reason: External backup files are deleted by the user through the system document provider, not by SproutPace.
Withdrawal is an explicit update; reset clears the whole workspace rather than exposing standalone consent deletion.
A default-on release preference always exists; users turn collection off instead of deleting the setting.

qualityGates.title: Repository build, tests, static analysis, coverage, and localization
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Run declared Gradle compilation, domain/Store/component/persistence/network tests, Detekt, filtered Kover, catalog/localization contracts, and hardcoded-string scan.

qualityGates.title: Android platform behavior and release build
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Build Android release/test variants and verify notifications, photo/document pickers, Yandex privacy ordering, Crashlytics configuration, process restart, and platform resources.

qualityGates.title: iOS compilation and platform behavior
qualityGates.verificationMethod: On macOS and CI build both iOS targets and verify native linkage, notifications, pickers, Crashlytics, resources, privacy behavior, and safe-disabled ads.

qualityGates.title: Release acceptance and independent audit
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify every active AC and required/active conditional gate against current fingerprints, complete the first-release visual review, and obtain the independent acceptance audit.

qualityGates.title: External store publication
qualityGates.condition: An Android build is being published to a production store.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify store account, signing, listing, Data Safety/privacy disclosures, current brand availability, country availability, and actual publication result.

qualityGates.title: Asset creation and production usage
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Run validate-assets.py, compile Compose Resources, verify manifest hashes/usages, and inspect every custom asset in production previews/goldens.

qualityGates.title: Preview, Paparazzi, accessibility, and Lazyweb design review
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Require nonzero preview discovery, deterministic light/dark and EN/RU/200% coverage, record-inspect-verify Paparazzi goldens, accessibility checks, and first-release Lazyweb review of all primary screens.

qualityGates.title: Firebase project configuration and symbolication
qualityGates.condition: Crashlytics-enabled release or release-candidate builds are produced for Android or iOS.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify separate Android and iOS Firebase app configuration, upload mapping/dSYM symbols, send controlled test crashes, and confirm readable reports without Analytics.

qualityGates.title: Android Yandex ad configuration
qualityGates.condition: An Android release candidate enables production advertising.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify the Android Yandex project/ad unit, release real-ID guard, debug test IDs, approved inline placements, and privacy-before-init on a device.

qualityGates.title: Privacy policy and store disclosures
qualityGates.condition: A build is prepared for external distribution.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Supply the approved privacy-policy URL and legal copy, then verify in-app links and platform/store disclosures for Yandex Ads and Crashlytics.

qualityGates.title: Catalog version, formulas, and offline resource completeness
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Validate the eight culture IDs, source metadata, metric formulas, version/date, EN/RU resource keys, and safety content without requiring external approvals or attestations.

qualityGates.title: Backup and replacement-restore round trip
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Round-trip fixtures containing every managed relationship and photos; verify invalid-input rollback, replacement semantics, reminder rebuild, and duplicate prevention.

constraints.offlineMode: All core setup, catalog, planning, batch, history, photo, export, and restore workflows use local data. Network failure may disable ads and crash upload but never the product core.
privacy: No account, product analytics, attribution, location, advertising identifier, user identifier, or user-authored grow content is sent by product code.
Yandex Ads is the only provider and remains off until the canonical region/consent gate permits initialization.
Crashlytics is release-default-on with a Settings opt-out and contains only minimized technical diagnostics.
accessibility: Support screen readers, keyboard/pointer input, reduced motion, 48dp targets, non-color state cues, EN/RU expansion, and 200% text without lost actions.
performance: Local reads and writes must not visibly block interaction; Today and batch detail open from local state without waiting for network; image work is bounded and off the main thread.

architecture.screenshotTestHostRationale: The shared Compose UI module owns the production screens, theme, fonts, resources, deterministic previews, generated Android-hosted Paparazzi tests, and snapshots for both product targets.

openQuestions.question: What final privacy-policy URL and legally approved consent/disclosure copy will be used?
openQuestions.resolution: Required only before external distribution; tracked by QG-010.

openQuestions.question: Which Android/iOS Firebase configuration files and console apps will be supplied?
openQuestions.resolution: Required for Crashlytics release candidates; tracked by QG-008.

openQuestions.question: Which Android Yandex production ad unit will be supplied?
openQuestions.resolution: Required only when Android production ads are enabled; tracked by QG-009. iOS production ads remain excluded.

openQuestions.question: When will several physical grow cycles validate the bundled intervals and density guidance?
openQuestions.resolution: Physical validation is an external follow-up; catalog versioning must not claim it has already occurred.
